SECURITY: never write secrets, tokens or passwords into any file, comment, log, brief or commit. Credentials come from the environment or an ephemeral session only. Do not run destructive commands (force-push, hard reset of shared branches, deleting remote branches or environments) unless the owner asked for it explicitly in this task. Environment changes must be scoped to the configured dev target ({{mutation_scope}}), reversible, and recorded. Never touch production.
